reviewed_records.label: Open In New
reviewed_records.depicts: An outward arrow showing content opening in a new destination.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show opening content in a new tab, new window, or external destination.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface opens content in a new tab, new window, or external destination.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for send or share when the meaning is specifically opening elsewhere.

reviewed_records.label: Workflow
reviewed_records.depicts: Workflow shown as a structured process or layered system symbol.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show a multi-step workflow, orchestration path, or linked automation sequence.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface needs to show a linked sequence of automated or agent-driven steps.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for a simple hierarchy, organization chart, or generic navigation pattern.
